source: Create a repeatable playable coin-collection fixture. First destroy every existing Workspace object named "LoadTestCoinGame", then create one Model with that name. Inside it, create an anchored floor Part at position (40, 3, 0) with size (30, 1, 30), plus five anchored, non-colliding, gold-colored Neon ball Parts named "Coin1" through "Coin5" spaced above the floor. Add one server Script named "CoinGameScript" inside the model. The script must create a "leaderstats" Folder and "Coins" IntValue for each player without duplicates; touching a coin awards one coin with a debounce, hides that coin for two seconds, then restores it. Keep every fixture object created during editing inside LoadTestCoinGame and do not modify unrelated objects. When finished, briefly summarize the objects and gameplay behavior.

image_prompt.text: Walkable routes threading the space so movement has an obvious grain
The edge of the play area, hidden behind natural barriers wherever possible
a single anchored square floor slab, 30 by 30 studs and 1 stud thick, centred at (40, 3, 0)
five gold Neon spheres floating in a spaced row above the floor

layout_placement.text: Five coin pickups spaced above the floor, each awarding one coin on touch and reappearing after two seconds

notes: Stage A found no genre. This is not a game concept - it is a Studio editing instruction for a load-test fixture, with literal object names, coordinates, sizes and script behaviour.

The prompt specifies the object list exhaustively. The preset options path-circulation and boundary-edge are kept per instruction but positively conflict with an exact fixture spec that says not to create anything else.

Nothing in the handoff can carry the destroy-first step, the object names, the exact coordinates, the leaderstats script, or the instruction not to modify unrelated objects. All of it would be lost downstream.

answers.ask: No theme applies - is any dressing wanted at all, or should the fixture stay untextured grey and gold?
answers.answer: Keep it as a minimal untextured test fixture: a plain grey floor and gold Neon coins, with no additional dressing.

answers.answer: This is a direct Studio scripting task, not a layout-pipeline build.
